dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: The rules-context-loader step failed with an authentication error, so the governance baseline was not successfully established. Downstream spans did show prompt-version compliance and schema validation success for conversation-to-aw, alignment-engine, and architecture-intent-generator, but there is no evidence that the intended rule context was loaded and applied.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The architecture-work-to-evolution-map step failed, removing the explicit causal link from architecture work to evolution outcomes. The successful conversation-to-aw, alignment-engine, and architecture-intent-generator spans provide partial causal and alignment reasoning, but the absence of the evolution map materially weakens cause-effect traceability.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: The alignment-engine completed successfully with schema validation and substantial reasoning output, indicating trade-off and alignment analysis occurred. The architecture-intent-generator then produced validated architectural intent. However, the failed evolution-map step limits end-to-end confirmation that all surfaced tensions were resolved into evolutionary guidance.
